findings.message:
Colon-separated matching corrupts URL queries

The colon-only separator branch allows `sanitizeAutoCloseKeywords("https://example.test/?fixes:#116")` to remove `fixes:` and produce `https://example.test/?#116`. This valid URL's `#116` is a fragment, so the change violates the source-body-preservation contract.

summary: The updated sanitizer can rewrite valid URL query text.
